## Class Questions

> - What do you want to talk about today?

## Basic Concepts

> - What is the difference between diversity, equity, and inclusion? Why do all three matter — and why aren't they the same thing?
> - What does it mean for communication to be a structural barrier? Give an example.
> - How do organizations communicate *about* DEI — and how do those communications sometimes undermine the stated goals?

## Basic Concepts (cont.)

> - What is the difference between diversity as a demographic fact and diversity as something that requires active inclusion to be valuable?
> - What does the research say about when diverse groups perform better — and when they don't?
> - How does this chapter connect to the critical and feminist approaches from Ch. 6?

## Basic Concepts (cont.)

> - What does "DEI as organizational change" mean — why frame it that way instead of as a set of policies?
> - What would communication look like in a genuinely inclusive organization, vs. one that performs inclusion?
